answer: The lantern lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the velvet is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the jetty of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, converted to a slow vesting stream, idle agents bleed standing.
